root_cause: Manual LinkedIn DM fallback existed conceptually but did not give the user one complete executable handoff containing recipient, connection context, final text, attachment and outcome controls.
decision: Project only irreducibly manual LinkedIn DM actions into Arthur Actions; make Powerhouse generate the final DM and any required PDF, then capture sent/defer/not-relevant outcomes so autonomous follow-up resumes.
prevention: Never ask the user to research which person or connection should receive a manual DM.
Never surface a manual DM without final ready-to-send text.
Never ask the user to create a required attachment; Powerhouse generates the PDF.
Never imply a LinkedIn connection degree without evidence.
Never place provider-executable actions in the manual queue.
evidence: Production bg_vandaag view now exposes manual_required, relationship state, estimated value, trigger and PDF requirement.
Production bg-dagoverzicht Edge Function version 5 can generate a PDF for an active sales action.
The Today cockpit implementation renders only manual actions and supports Copy DM, PDF generation, Sent, Later and Not relevant.
